Hozd létre az environment konfigurációt és konfiguráld a HttpClient-et:

1. Hozd létre a `client/src/environments/environment.ts` fájlt egy `apiUrl: 'http://localhost:3000/api'` mezővel.
2. Hozd létre a `client/src/environments/environment.prod.ts` fájlt production URL-lel.
3. Az `app.config.ts`-ben add hozzá a `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([]))` konfigurációt (az interceptor tömb egyelőre üres, később töltjük fel).

Csak ezeket a fájlokat módosítsd, mást ne. A meglévő provideRouter és provideAnimations maradjon.

Az Angular projektben jelenleg az autentikáció in-memory tömbbel működik (USERS tömb). A backend API a következő végpontokkal rendelkezik:

- POST /api/auth/login  
  Body: { email: string, password: string }  
  Response: { token: string, user: { id: string, username: string, role: string } }

- POST /api/auth/register  
  Body: { username: string, email: string, password: string }  
  Response: { user: {...}, token: string }

Hozz létre egy `AuthService`-t a `client/src/app/services/auth.service.ts` fájlban:

1. @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }), HttpClient injektálás, environment.apiUrl használata.
2. `login(credentials)` metódus: POST kérés, a kapott token-t és user objektumot mentse localStorage-ba ('token' és 'currentUser' kulcsokkal). Használj `tap` operátort.
3. `register(data)` metódus: POST kérés a regisztrációhoz, sikeres válasz esetén automatikusan mentse a token-t és user-t (ugyanaz a logika mint login-nál).
4. `logout()`: törölje a localStorage-ból a token-t és user-t.
5. `getToken()`: adja vissza a tárolt token-t (string | null).
6. `getCurrentUser()`: parse-olja és adja vissza a tárolt user objektumot (vagy null).
7. `isLoggedIn()`: boolean, van-e token.
8. `isAdmin()`: boolean, a currentUser role-ja 'admin'-e.

A meglévő `in-memory/models.ts`-ben definiált User interface-t használd (importáld onnan), de egészítsd ki egy opcionális `token?: string` mezővel ha szükséges, vagy hozz létre egy külön `LoginResponse` interface-t a service fájlban.

Az Angular projektben a recepteket jelenleg az in-memory RECIPES tömbből olvassuk. A backend API végpontjai:

- GET    /api/recipes              → Recipe[]  (opcionális query param: ?category=categoryId)
- GET    /api/recipes/:id          → Recipe
- POST   /api/recipes              → Recipe  (admin, body: { title, description, categoryId, ingredients })
- PUT    /api/recipes/:id          → Recipe  (admin)
- DELETE /api/recipes/:id          → 204     (admin)

A meglévő frontend Recipe model (`in-memory/models.ts`):
```typescript
export interface Ingredient {
  name: string;
  quantity: string;
}
export interface Recipe {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  categoryId: string;
  ingredients: Ingredient[];
  createdBy: string;
  createdAt: Date;
}
```

A MongoDB `_id` mezőt használ, ezért a backend response-okban `_id` jön vissza `id` helyett.

1. @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }), HttpClient és environment.apiUrl használata.

3. `getRecipeById(id: string)`: GET kérés, szintén _id → id mapping.
4. `createRecipe(data)`: POST kérés.
5. `updateRecipe(id, data)`: PUT kérés.
6. `deleteRecipe(id)`: DELETE kérés.

Minden metódusba tegyél `catchError` operátort, ami console.error-ral logolja a hibát és `throwError`-ral továbbdobja.

summaries.text:
1. Conversation Overview:
- Primary Objectives:
  - "Hozd létre az environment konfigurációt és konfiguráld a HttpClient-et" — add environment files and register HttpClient.
  - Implement authentication tied to backend (`AuthService`, login/register) and add an HTTP interceptor to include JWT tokens on requests.
  - Replace frontend in-memory data usage (RECIPES, CATEGORIES, RATINGS, USERS) with backend calls via services (`RecipeService`, `CategoryService`, `RatingService`).
  - Fix server CORS so Angular dev app can call API.
  - Fix DB seed script so `recipes.categoryId` matches category `_id`.
  - Resolve UI change-detection problem (async HTTP results not rendering until user interaction).
- Session Context: The work began with small config changes (environment, HttpClient), expanded to auth and interceptor, then moved to service-based refactorings across the frontend, and ended with database seed fixes and change-detection patches to get the UI to reflect server data immediately.
- User Intent Evolution: Started with environment + HttpClient setup → moved to authentication wiring → then full refactor to backend-driven data (services) → DB seed corrections → debugging async UI updates (detectChanges workaround applied). The user is focused on moving from in-memory demo data to actual backend integration and ensuring the UI updates correctly.

2. Technical Foundation:
- Angular: Standalone app (workspace shows Angular 21); used `provideRouter`, `provideAnimations`, and `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([...]))`.
- Interceptor pattern: Angular 17+ functional interceptor (`HttpInterceptorFn`) + `inject(AuthService)`.
- HTTP & RxJS: `HttpClient`, operators `map`, `tap`, `catchError`, `throwError`.
- Change detection: `ChangeDetectorRef.detectChanges()` used as a pragmatic fix; alternative: use `NgZone.run(...)` or ensure operations occur in Angular zone.
- Backend: Express.js routes under `/api`, MongoDB with repositories/services; DB seeded via `server/docker-init/mongo-init.js`.
- Docker Compose: frontend at port 4200, backend 3000, mongo 27017; init scripts mount to Mongo container.

3. Codebase Status (key files):
- client/src/environments/environment.ts — dev API URL: 'http://localhost:3000/api' (added).
- client/src/environments/environment.prod.ts — prod API URL (added).
- client/src/app/app.config.ts — providers include `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`, `provideRouter(routes)`, `provideAnimations()`.
- client/src/app/services/auth.service.ts — `login`, `register` (store token & user in localStorage), `logout`, `getToken`, `getCurrentUser`, `isLoggedIn`, `isAdmin`.
- client/src/app/interceptors/auth.interceptor.ts — functional interceptor adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>` if token present.
- client/src/app/auth/login/login.ts — calls `authService.login(...)`, shows SnackBar, navigates on success.
- client/src/app/auth/register/register.ts — calls `authService.register(...)`, handles 409 by setting form error `exists: true`.
- client/src/app/services/recipe.service.ts — `getRecipes(category?)`, `getRecipeById`, `createRecipe`, `updateRecipe`, `deleteRecipe`, `_id→id` mapping via `normalizeRecipe`.
- client/src/app/services/category.service.ts — CRUD + `_id→id` mapping.
- client/src/app/services/rating.service.ts — CRUD + `getRatingsByRecipe(recipeId)` (client-side filtering).
- client/src/app/recipes/recipe-list/recipe-list.ts — now loads recipes & categories from services, builds `categoryMap`, uses `ChangeDetectorRef.detectChanges()`, logout calls `authService.logout()`.
- client/src/app/recipes/recipe-detail/recipe-detail.ts — loads recipe via `recipeService.getRecipeById`, then ratings via `ratingService.getRatingsByRecipe`, category via `categoryService.getCategoryById`; `onRatingSaved()` refreshes ratings from server; uses `cd.detectChanges()` to force UI update; navigates to `/recipes` on 404.
